title: Back button on mouse while in help does different depending on if you click or ctrl+click
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.beta1.official [d33da79d3]
v4.4.beta2.official [a013481b0]

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta2 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 9 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-11900K @ 3.50GHz (16 threads)

### Issue description

When ctrl+clicking on some method or object you are taken to the help document for it.
If you ctrl+click on one of the properties it will take you to that item, and then the back button works, but takes you completely out of the help and back to the script.
If you just click on one of the properties it will take you to that item, but then the back button on the mouse does nothing.
After that it seems to break the back button if it is the same item. Doing a different item will be a reset result

I would assume that the click or ctrl+click the back button should work the same.
Also I would think that doing back or forward buttons should traverse the document like a history of back and forward similar to how website linked hashes are. (That being said I have no idea how hard that would be to implement)

### Steps to reproduce

In a script
Ctrl+click on some object or function
Ctrl+click on a property then try mouse back button, and it will take you completely back to the script

Go back to script
Ctrl+click again on that object or function
Left click on a property then try mouse back button, it does nothing

You can do a ctrl+click again on the same item and it will get stuck which seems to break the back button after the left click.
However if you pick a different item from the help list, it will go back to script when using a back button from a ctrl+click
